newsitem.title: ITALY: Compart sells Calcestruzzi to Italcementi.
newsitem.headline: Compart sells Calcestruzzi to Italcementi.

text.p: Italian financial holding group Compart said it had sold its Italian concrete group Calcestruzzi SpA to Italcementi for a financial benefit of 500 billion lire.

Compart, formerly Ferruzzi Finanziaria, said its holding group Calcemento was selling off all of its Italian concrete interest as Calcestruzzi. Calcemento will continue to hold Compart's Greek building product interests.

Compart said in a statement this was the single biggest sell-off in its disposal process which had now raised over five trillion lire since Compart's restructuring process was started after the company faced severe financial difficulties in 1993.
The financial benefit received by Compart will include around 150 billion lire in cash and 350 billion lire in transferred debt.

In a second operation, Compart will pay 18 billion lire to Italcementi for a 21.14 percent stake in holding company Calfince to bring Compart's holding up to 100 percent in Calfince. Calfince SpA holds a 50.29 percent stake in Calcemento SpA. (( -- Milan newsroom +392 66129502 ))
